questions.question: You’re at a party and someone spills their drink on your new jacket. What would be the most appropriate response if you wanted to apologise sincerely?
options: Don’t worry about it, it’s fine!
I’m so sorry about this! I’ll get you a new one.
It’s not your fault; you just need to dry it out.
You should have looked where you were going.
questions.answer: I’m so sorry about this! I’ll get you a new one.

questions.question: Your friend suggests going to a movie tonight, but you prefer to stay in and watch a series. Which response would best express your opinion while maintaining a polite tone?
options: Sure, let’s go! I’ll pick you up at seven.
I don’t think I can go—I’d rather stay home and watch something.
Movies are boring; let’s just watch TV.
You’re always so tired; maybe you should rest.
questions.answer: I don’t think I can go—I’d rather stay home and watch something.

questions.question: Your colleague asks you to help with a project that’s already behind schedule. What would be the most appropriate way to politely offer help?
options: No, I’m too busy with my own work—let someone else do it.
Of course! I’ll take a look and see how I can assist.
That’s not my job; I’ll leave it to you.
I’m not sure I can help—I’ve got other tasks to finish.
questions.answer: Of course! I’ll take a look and see how I can assist.

questions.question: At a formal dinner, someone asks if you’d like dessert. How would you best respond to show appreciation?
options: No, I’m full—I’ll just have water.
Oh, that sounds lovely! Thank you very much.
I don’t like sweets, so I’ll pass.
You should try it; it’s amazing!
questions.answer: Oh, that sounds lovely! Thank you very much.

questions.question: Your boss asks you if you’d like to take the lead on a new initiative. You’re unsure but want to show enthusiasm for the opportunity. Which response would be the most appropriate?
options: I don’t think I’m qualified for that.
That would be great! I’d love to take it on.
I’m not sure, but I’ll think about it.
You’re too kind; I don’t deserve this.
questions.answer: That would be great! I’d love to take it on.
